responsibility: This file implements optional invocation of the external C preprocessor for mc input files. It builds a temporary output filename, assembles and executes the configured preprocessor command line from mcOptions, returns either the original source name or the preprocessed temporary file, tracks all generated temporary files in an alists list, and installs a termination hook to delete them on exit, making it the compiler's preprocessing and temporary-file cleanup layer.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file contains the actual preprocessing workflow declared by GmcPreprocess.h, including command construction from mcOptions, temporary-file tracking, external command execution, and exit-time cleanup registration.
